**Analyzing Containment Logic**

I'm now zeroing in on the "bottommost contained shape" concept. I'm focusing on how the example clarifies this rule. Right now, I'm attempting to identify how shapes are contained within one another to determine the lowest one. I've noted that "2s reach" – I am interpreting the relationships of the shapes.
